name: changedetection
title: ChangeDetection.io
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：使用 Firefox 140.11 ESR + geckodriver/Selenium，不是 Playwright；OpenCV SSIM 使用 numpy 1.26.4。

缺失功能：无本地 Chrome；可配置远程 Chrome WebDriver。

额外依赖：需 --shm-size=1g；5000；持久化 /datastore。

镜像说明：0.60.9；SQLite；内置 Firefox 140.11ESR + geckodriver 0.37.1；Selenium 步骤适配层支持 Goto/点击/输入/等待/选择/按键/滚动/JS/复选框等（不再依赖 Playwright）；OpenCV 4.5.2 + numpy 1.26.4，SSIM 可用；Chrome 远程仍可 `WEBDRIVER_BROWSER=chrome` + `WEBDRIVER_URL`；5000
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: Uses Firefox 140.11 ESR with geckodriver/Selenium instead of Playwright; OpenCV SSIM uses numpy 1.26.4.

Missing features: No local Chrome; a remote Chrome WebDriver can be configured.

Extra dependencies: Needs --shm-size=1g; port 5000; persist /datastore.

Image notes: 0.60.9；SQLite；内置 Firefox 140.11ESR + geckodriver 0.37.1；Selenium 步骤适配层支持 Goto/点击/输入/等待/选择/按键/滚动/JS/复选框等（不再依赖 Playwright）；OpenCV 4.5.2 + numpy 1.26.4，SSIM 可用；Chrome 远程仍可 `WEBDRIVER_BROWSER=chrome` + `WEBDRIVER_URL`；5000

notes: 未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
